## Latency trend (InvocationLatency, daily, us-east-1)

Days with no traffic are missing from the series, so each shape below rests on few data points.

- **`us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-5`** is the only model with real volume. Data covers 11 of the last 15 days (none on Nov 15, 18, 21, 22), with 113 to 1,986 calls per day.

  - p90 is mostly 11 to 15s, with two spikes to ~40s on Nov 10 (39.9s) and Nov 17 (41.5s).
  - I found no sustained p50 increase in this window. The worst days were Nov 10 and Nov 17.
- **`us.amazon.nova-lite-v1:0`** has only 6 days of data at about 90 calls per day. p50 drifted from 990ms (Nov 10) to 1,156ms (Nov 24), about +17%, with p90 around 1.3 to 1.7s. The drift is gradual with no step.
- **Titan embed v2** rose from 113ms (Nov 10) to 131ms (Nov 24), peaking at 153ms on Nov 16.
- **`amazon.nova-lite-v1:0`** (no `us.` prefix) has 2 to 3 calls per day and p50 of 219 to 324ms.
- **Sonnet 4.5** has 1 to 2 calls per day, and **gpt-5.6-terra** has one day of data (Nov 17, 155 calls, p50 715ms). Both are too thin to judge.

## Gaps that limit diagnosis

1. **No Bedrock alarms and no client-side latency.** No metric covers end-to-end latency for the calling app, so you can't separate Bedrock-side latency from network, SDK retry or app-side queueing.
2. **No traces.** X-Ray is empty, so there are no per-request spans or retry data.
3. **Sparse series.** Most models get a handful of calls per day, and Sonnet 5 had four zero-traffic days. Claims about a regression on those models are statistically weak.
4. **TimeToFirstToken exists only for Nova Lite.** For streaming workloads on Sonnet 5, you can't split first-token latency from generation time.
5. **No retention on the invocation log group.** It also has no metric filters, and only text and video delivery are on.

## Cheapest fixes

1. **Add CloudWatch alarms** on `InvocationLatency` p90 and `InvocationThrottles` per ModelId, starting with Sonnet 5. Add an anomaly-detection alarm if you want it cheap.
2. **Turn on tracing for the calling apps** (X-Ray or OTel via Application Signals) in the Lambdas and AgentCore runtimes that call Bedrock. This gives client-side latency and retry spans.
3. **Set retention on `/aws/bedrock-agentcore/runtimes/*` and the invocation log group** (for example 30 to 90 days). Optionally add an S3 destination for invocation logs. Also use streaming APIs where possible, so TimeToFirstToken is emitted for Sonnet 5.

## Deeper follow-ups, if wanted
